label: IotaWatt Retention
info: Permanent hourly archive with guarded retention pruning. Calls maintain_iotawatt_retention() daily at 03:40 America/Denver, retains 14 days of raw data and 30 days of minute data, and alerts if archive or enabled prune success is older than 36 hours.

nodes.name: Retention succeeded
Check archive + prune success
nodes.template:
SELECT
    LastArchiveSuccessUTC,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LastArchiveSuccessUTC, UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS ArchiveAgeHours,
    LastPruneSuccessUTC,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, LastPruneSuccessUTC, UTC_TIMESTAMP()) AS PruneAgeHours,
    PruningEnabled,
    ReadyToPrune
FROM v_iotawatt_pruning_readiness
WHERE Id=1;

nodes.name: Alert if older than 36h
Build retention failure alert
Permanent hourly archive + guarded 14d raw / 30d minute pruning
nodes.info: Daily maintenance archives complete hours first, validates exact archive coverage, then prunes source rows in bounded timestamp-key batches. Pruning requires GrafanaMigrated=1, ConsumersMigrated=1, and PruningEnabled=1; any validation mismatch aborts deletion and is logged.
